TextZh:
修仙并不容易。
有人天生天灵根。
有人出生在仙门。
而{name}拥有：
一件黑色卫衣。
和一颗不想上班的心。
TextEn:
Cultivation isn't easy.
Some are born with heavenly roots.
Some are born into great sects.
And {name} has:
one black hoodie.
and a heart that doesn't want to go to work.

TextZh:
今年16岁。
修为：0。
灵石：0。
梦想：飞升成仙。
现实：先活过今天。
TextEn:
Sixteen years old.
Cultivation: 0.
Spirit stones: 0.
Dream: ascend to immortality.
Reality: survive today first.

TextZh: 没人知道未来会发生什么。\n也许明天突破。\n也许明天被鹅追杀。
TextEn: Nobody knows what tomorrow brings.\nMaybe a breakthrough.\nMaybe being chased by a goose.

TextZh: 天道无情。\n命运难测。\n但总得试试看。
TextEn: Heaven is merciless.\nFate is unpredictable.\nBut you still have to try.

TextZh:
修仙路上最不缺天才。
最缺的。
是坚持。
以及不要半路睡着。
TextEn: The cultivation world has plenty of geniuses.\nWhat it lacks is persistence.\nAnd people who don't nap halfway.

TextZh: 成为仙人很难。\n成为废物却很简单。\n{name}决定先走中间路线。
TextEn: Becoming immortal is hard.\nBecoming useless is easy.\n{name} chooses the middle path for now.

TextZh: 故事开始了。\n至于结局。\n连天道都还没写完。
TextEn: The story begins.\nAs for the ending,\neven heaven hasn't finished writing it.

TextZh: 命运给{name}发了张牌。\n牌面是：\n引气一层，零修为，一身轻松。
TextEn: Fate dealt {name} a hand.\nThe cards say:\nQi Drawing I, zero cultivation, no burden at all.

TextZh: 有人修仙是为了长生。\n{name}修仙是为了不上班。\n目标也算明确。
TextEn: Some cultivate for immortality.\n{name} cultivates to avoid work.\nAt least the goal is clear.

TextZh: 据说每个人都有自己的道。\n{name}的道。\n暂时还在找。
TextEn: They say everyone has their own Dao.\n{name}'s Dao is currently missing.\nSearch in progress.

TextZh: 天地不仁。\n以万物为刍狗。\n{name}表示理解，但有点慌。
TextEn: Heaven and earth are impartial.\n{name} understands.\n{name} is also slightly panicking.

TextZh: 传说每个废柴修士。\n都有觉醒的那一天。\n传说还在继续验证。
TextEn: Legend says every hopeless cultivator awakens one day.\nThe legend is still under testing.

TextZh: {name}的修仙之路。\n从一无所有开始。\n也算公平。
TextEn: {name}'s cultivation journey begins with nothing.\nFair enough.

TextZh: 有些人生来注定非凡。\n{name}生来注定先试试看。
TextEn: Some are born extraordinary.\n{name} was born to give it a try first.

TextZh: {name}抬头看了看天。\n天没说话。\n修仙，就这么开始了。
TextEn: {name} looked up at the sky.\nThe sky said nothing.\nAnd so cultivation began.

TextZh: 修仙第一步：起名。\n修仙第二步：还没想好。
TextEn: Step one of cultivation: get a name.\nStep two: still under consideration.

TextZh: 据说修仙需要悟性。\n{name}的悟性还在路上。\n大概在堵车。
TextEn: Cultivation requires insight.\n{name}'s insight is on the way.\nProbably stuck in traffic.

TextZh: {name}的灵根检测结果：普通。\n但精神状态：异常昂扬。
TextEn: {name}'s root test result: ordinary.\nMental state: suspiciously enthusiastic.

TextZh: 修仙最忌三天打鱼两天晒网。\n{name}记下了。\n但不保证会改。
TextEn: Cultivation dislikes inconsistent effort.\n{name} wrote that down.\nNo promise to change.

TextZh: {name}今天的修炼计划：\n先睡一觉。\n起来再说。
TextEn: {name}'s training plan today:\nnap first.\nDiscuss after waking up.

TextZh: 有人说吃得苦中苦，方为人上人。\n{name}决定先吃饭。\n苦的事以后再说。
TextEn: They say hardship makes greatness.\n{name} chooses food first.\nHardship can wait.

TextZh:
修仙不是一蹴而就的。
是要一蹴。
再蹴。
再蹴很多次。
TextEn:
Cultivation isn't done in one step.
It takes one step,
then another,
then far too many.

TextZh: {name}的人生信条：\n修炼要努力。\n摆烂也不能落后。
TextEn: {name}'s life motto:\ntrain hard,\nbut never fall behind in slacking either.

TextZh: 今天是{name}修仙的第一天。\n也可能是摸鱼生涯的第一天。\n两者并不矛盾。
TextEn: Today is {name}'s first day cultivating.\nIt may also be the first day of professional slacking.\nBoth can be true.

TextZh: 传说中的天纵奇才。\n一出生就会修炼。\n{name}出生那天，主要在哭。
TextEn: Legendary geniuses cultivate from birth.\nOn {name}'s birth day,\nthe main activity was crying.

TextZh: 越努力越幸运。\n{name}决定先验证一下。\n实验周期：不确定。
TextEn: The harder you work, the luckier you get.\n{name} will test this theory.\nExperiment duration: unclear.

TextZh: 据{name}自己分析。\n唯一的天赋可能是：\n抗揍。
TextEn: According to {name}'s own analysis,\nthe only talent might be:\ntaking hits.

TextZh: 修仙界很卷。\n{name}决定躺平迎接这份卷。
TextEn: The cultivation world is competitive.\n{name} chooses to lie down and face it calmly.

TextZh: {name}发誓要成为人上人。\n然后觉得地上躺着也挺好。
TextEn: {name} swore to rise above everyone.\nThen realized the floor is also quite comfortable.

TextZh: 修仙如逆水行舟，不进则退。\n{name}觉得：那至少先别沉。
TextEn: Cultivation is like rowing upstream.\n{name}'s first goal: don't sink.

TextZh: 今天{name}立下宏愿：\n要修炼一万年。\n至于从哪天开始，明天再决定。
TextEn: Today {name} made a grand vow:\ntrain for ten thousand years.\nThe start date can be decided tomorrow.

TextZh: {name}的座右铭：\n修仙先修心。\n修心先睡觉。
TextEn: {name}'s motto:\ncultivate the heart first.\nRest the heart first-first.

TextZh: 坚持就能成功。\n{name}打算先坚持躺一会儿。
TextEn: Persistence leads to success.\n{name} will persist at lying down for a while.

TextZh: 天选之子的标配是惊艳出场。\n{name}的标配是黑卫衣，普通出场。
TextEn: Chosen ones make dramatic entrances.\n{name} enters normally, in a black hoodie.

TextZh:
{name}的开局属性：
帅气值正常。
天赋值正常。
摆烂值：爆表。
TextEn:
{name}'s starting stats:
Looks: normal.
Talent: normal.
Slacking: off the chart.

TextZh:
凡人时期的{name}。
最大愿望是不上班。
修仙时期的{name}。
愿望没有变化。
TextEn: As a mortal, {name}'s biggest wish was not to work.\nAs a cultivator,\nthat wish remains unchanged.

TextZh: {name}决定把修仙当成一份工作。\n区别是：没有老板。\n坏消息：老板可能是天道。
TextEn: {name} decided to treat cultivation like a job.\nDifference: no boss.\nBad news: heaven might be the boss.

TextZh: 修仙理由很朴素：\n比上班好。\n应该吧。
TextEn: The reason for cultivating is simple:\nprobably better than going to work.

TextZh: 即便是修仙界，也逃不过一句话：\n先苦后甜。\n{name}决定先问问甜在哪里。
TextEn: Even cultivation follows one rule:\nbitter first, sweet later.\n{name} would like to locate the sweet part first.

TextZh: 有些人含着金灵根出生。\n{name}含着一颗想躺平的心出生。
TextEn: Some are born with golden roots.\n{name} was born with a heart that wants to lie flat.

TextZh: 天道说，修仙之路漫长且孤独。\n{name}说：那正好，不用社交了。
TextEn: Heaven says cultivation is long and lonely.\n{name} says: great, less socializing.

TextZh: 有人说修仙没有捷径。\n{name}觉得，至少也该有个电梯。
TextEn: They say there are no shortcuts in cultivation.\n{name} thinks there should at least be an elevator.

TextZh: 未来的路很长。\n但{name}已经迈出第一步：\n穿上了黑色卫衣。
TextEn: The road ahead is long.\nBut {name} has taken the first step:\nputting on the black hoodie.

TextZh: {name}对未来没有太多规划。\n只知道比昨天强一点就够了。
TextEn: {name} doesn't have a grand plan.\nBeing a little better than yesterday is enough.

TextZh: 不是所有人都能飞升。\n但所有人都可以认真活一次。\n{name}决定从这次开始。
TextEn: Not everyone ascends.\nBut everyone can live one life seriously.\n{name} starts with this one.

TextZh: 修仙界没有保送名额。\n{name}也没指望有。\n公平竞争，挺好。
TextEn: There are no guaranteed admissions in cultivation.\n{name} didn't expect one.\nFair enough.

TextZh: {name}的使命暂时还没下载完成。\n请稍后再试。
TextEn: {name}'s destiny is still downloading.\nPlease try again later.

TextZh: {name}的起点很低。\n但起点低，不代表上限低。\n至少他这么希望。
TextEn: {name}'s starting point is low.\nA low start doesn't mean a low ceiling.\nAt least, that's the hope.

TextZh: {name}的故事，从一个普通下午开始。\n没有特效，没有BGM。\n但故事确实开始了。
TextEn: {name}'s story begins on an ordinary afternoon.\nNo effects, no BGM.\nBut it begins.

TextZh: 就这样。\n{name}的修仙之路。\n正式开始。
TextEn: And so,\n{name}'s cultivation journey\nofficially begins.
